description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 20.05.2019 to 26.05.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) to determine and publish new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically setting exchange rates for calculating duties, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
